rituals.title: QUEUE MASTER
rituals.name: QUEUE MASTER
rituals.unique_game_move: serialize simultaneous thought arrivals
rituals.match_reason: Best For: Mental overload; engine: serialize simultaneous thought arrivals
rituals.mission: Force multiple arrivals into a one-at-a-time queue.
rituals.rule: Only one item can occupy the front slot.
rituals.one_rule: Only one item can occupy the front slot.
rituals.play: When several thoughts compete, imagine numbered tickets. Process only the lowest number for three beats; all others wait silently.
rituals.twist: After three beats, move the front ticket to the back without solving it.
rituals.win: Competition becomes an orderly sequence rather than a pile-up.
rituals.winReward: Competition becomes an orderly sequence rather than a pile-up.
rituals.mind_bend: Mental overload can come from simultaneous competition, not sheer quantity; sequencing the arrivals changes the pressure without deleting any of them.

ROBOT READ

MISSION
Flatten a charged sentence into machine speech.

ONE RULE
No emotion acting.

PLAY
Replay one manageable sentence in a perfectly mechanical, evenly timed voice.

TWIST
Do not make it funny on purpose.

WIN
Emotional prosody separates from the words themselves.

MIND BEND
When expressive prosody is removed, the same words lose part of their emotional force; tone is carrying information the sentence never states.

SAFETY
ROBOT READ: use manageable inner wording for one pass. Flatten a charged sentence into machine speech. If more shame or fear develops, stop ROBOT READ and leave the sentence alone.

CUE-TRIGGER PROMISE

MISSION
Plant one intention and see whether its cue retrieves it later.

ONE RULE
The action is performed only when the cue appears.

PLAY
Set this rule: 'When I see the word BLUE, I will think TAP.' Now count backward 20, 19, 18, 17, 16. Then present yourself the sequence GREEN, BLUE, RED and notice whether TAP returns at BLUE.

TWIST
Do not rehearse TAP while counting backward.

WIN
A delayed cue retrieves an earlier intention after attention was occupied elsewhere.

MIND BEND
A future cue can retrieve an intended action after distraction, revealing prospective memory as a stored cue-action link rather than continuous rehearsal.

SAFETY
CUE-TRIGGER PROMISE boundary: information safe to forget. Plant one intention and see whether its cue retrieves it later. If repeated self-testing shows up, stop CUE-TRIGGER PROMISE and release the items.

rituals.recognition_cue: Mind play • Mental reset · SYLLOGISM CHECK

rituals.mission: Decide whether the conclusion is forced by the premises.
rituals.play: Premise 1: All robins are birds. Premise 2: All birds are animals. Conclusion: All robins are animals. Decide VALID or NOT VALID.
rituals.twist: Then explain the link in one short chain: robin → bird → animal.

rituals.mind_bend: A conclusion can be valid because class membership chains through the given premises, revealing logical entailment as something stricter than whether the conclusion merely sounds plausible.
